# Inverse Estimates

[Project home](../../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Original inverse-estimated activation/excitation references. They are not measured EMG and are not the final applied 104-channel waveform.

- [excitation.tsv](excitation.tsv) — Source inverse-estimated excitation reference, dimensionless; the applied 104-channel input is in Muscle_Excitation_Input/excitation_cycle.tsv.
- [optimized_activation.tsv](optimized_activation.tsv) — Source inverse-estimated activation reference, dimensionless; it is not activation calculated by the current forward run.
